patterns.note: A single vibrant, warm coral color is used as a dominant accent for the full-width header and footer sections, creating strong visual bookends for the content.
Content cards are consistently arranged in a three-column grid, each featuring an image, a small category tag, and a title, maintaining a clean and organized presentation.

The site employs a striking typographic contrast, using a large, friendly, and slightly quirky display serif for the main introductory text and a pixelated monospace font for major section headings like 'Experiments'.
The primary header bar at the top of the page is sticky and transforms on scroll, reducing its height and compacting its navigation elements to occupy less vertical space.
Category tags on content cards are styled as small, uppercase text within distinctively colored, pill-shaped backgrounds, providing clear visual categorization.

technique_notes: The main header uses a sticky positioning effect, where its height and internal padding/font sizes are animated to a more compact state as the user scrolls past the initial viewport, remaining fixed at the top.
Content is organized into a responsive three-column grid for articles and projects, with each item consistently structured with an image, a small category label, and a title.
Major section breaks are visually emphasized by full-width background color blocks and unique, large-scale typography, creating clear divisions in the page flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: A large, friendly display serif (~3x body) is used for the personal introduction, contrasted with a pixelated monospace font for major section headings (~2x body). Body and navigation text are smaller, clean monospace.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (for card images and category pills), with sharp corners for overall layout blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks and a consistent, moderate grid gap for content cards.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its playful yet professional brand identity, achieved through the unique combination of a large, friendly display serif for personal introductions and a pixelated monospace font for section headings. The vibrant coral accent color, used strategically for structural elements, further reinforces a memorable and energetic aesthetic.
